description.narrative:
The recently agreed Sustainable Development goals and the AU 2063 agenda will be significant in influencing African country and donor policies and spending over the next generation at national and local level.
SECAM therefore will call together 30 leaders from across the continent, including representatives of National Justice and Peace and Caritas groups, regional conferences, and theologians to develop an advocacy strategy at continental level that will determine priority issues for engagement and will establish better coordination mechanisms at national, regional and continental level.
The specific objectives for the design, running and follow up to the meeting i. To develop a clear advocacy strategy at AU and Nation and Regional levels for engaging with the implementation of the AU Agenda 2063, SDGs and Climate Change Agreement. ii. To create strong working relationships with National and Regional Conferences which will enable better information flow and advocacy to be rooted in experiences on the ground and to clarify the different roles and ways of working between continental, regional and national level conferences. iii. To identify any on-going needs for capacity strengthening in advocacy
